reading.title: The Discovery of Exoplanets
reading.passage: The first exoplanet was discovered in 1995 orbiting a star similar to our Sun. Since then, astronomers have identified over 5,000 planets outside our solar system using various detection methods. The transit method, which observes the slight dimming of a star as a planet passes in front of it, has proven particularly effective. These discoveries have fundamentally changed our understanding of planetary formation and suggest that habitable worlds may be far more common than previously believed.

questions.q: According to the passage, when was the first exoplanet discovered?
options: In the 1980s
In the 2000s
questions.explanation: 지문에서 명확하게 'The first exoplanet was discovered in 1995'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about the transit method?
options: It is the only way to detect exoplanets
It is particularly successful in finding exoplanets
It was discovered before 1995
It cannot detect habitable planets
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'The transit method...has proven particularly effective'라고 언급하여 이 방법이 특히 효과적임을 암시합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Immigration policies should prioritize skilled workers over family reunification. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 도입부: 이민 정책의 기준에 대한 prompt를 다시 표현하고, 당신의 입장(skilled workers vs family reunification 중 선택)을 명확히 제시하세요. 예: 'While some argue that skilled workers benefit the economy, I believe that family reunification should be equally prioritized in immigration policy.'
structure.body1: 본론 1: 첫 번째 입장을 뒷받침하는 이유 제시. 예를 들어, 인도적 가치, 사회 통합, 또는 경제적 이점 중 하나를 선택하여 구체적 사례와 함께 설명하세요.
structure.body2: 본론 2: 두 번째 이유 제시. 첫 번째와 다른 각도(사회적, 경제적, 정책적)에서 논증하고, 반대 입장의 약점을 간접적으로 언급할 수 있습니다.
structure.conclusion: 결론: thesis를 재표현하고, 두 body 문단의 핵심을 요약한 후, 이민 정책의 균형잡힌 접근의 중요성으로 마무리하세요.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to shop online. Others prefer to shop in physical stores. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details in your response.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer shopping...
sample_points: 배송 시간 vs 즉시 구매 편의성 중 하나 선택 후 설명
온라인은 가격 비교 용이 또는 매장은 제품 직접 확인 가능 중 하나 선택
개인의 생활 방식과 우선순위에 따른 최종 선택 이유

listening.title: Dormitory Room Assignment
listening.script:
Student A: Hi, I'm here to ask about my dorm room assignment for next semester. I submitted my request three weeks ago, but I haven't received any confirmation yet.

Housing Officer: Let me check your file. Can you give me your student ID number?

Student A: Sure, it's 5847293.

Housing Officer: Okay, I found it. According to our records, you requested a single room with a campus view. Unfortunately, single rooms are very limited this year due to increased enrollment. However, we can offer you a double room in the North Tower, which is quite close to the library.

Student A: I see. Is there any possibility of getting a single room later if one becomes available?

Housing Officer: Absolutely. We maintain a waiting list. If a single room opens up, we'll contact you immediately. Many students accept the double room and then transfer once space becomes available. The North Tower is actually one of our newest buildings with excellent facilities.

Student A: That sounds reasonable. I'll take the double room then. When will I know my roommate assignment?

Housing Officer: You'll receive that information by email within two weeks. Welcome to the North Tower!

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: The student is complaining about dorm fees
The student is inquiring about their dorm room assignment
The housing officer is explaining dorm rules
The student is requesting to change dormitories
questions.explanation: 학생이 처음부터 'I'm here to ask about my dorm room assignment'이라고 명시하며, 기숙사 배정 상황을 확인하려고 합니다.

questions.q: What does the housing officer suggest to the student?
options: Wait another month for a room assignment
Accept a double room and possibly transfer to a single later
Choose a different dormitory building
Submit another housing request form
questions.explanation: 주택 담당자는 'Many students accept the double room and then transfer once space becomes available'라고 제안하며, 싱글 룸이 생기면 대기 명단에서 연락할 것이라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: Why does the housing officer mention the North Tower's facilities?
options: To convince the student to accept the double room offer
To explain why single rooms are unavailable
To inform the student about dorm policies
To encourage the student to change their preference
questions.explanation: 주택 담당자는 North Tower의 현대적 시설과 장점을 설명함으로써 학생이 더블 룸 제안을 수락하도록 설득하려는 의도를 보입니다.
